ext_description.message: 在地址栏搜索，或把文字拖到标签栏，用两个搜索引擎打开 Chrome 拆分视图，左右对比结果。
ext_description.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

ext_action_title.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button, which opens the Split Search popup. Keep the product name Split Search untranslated.

go_status_opening.description: Status line on the trigger page while the split view is being opened (shown only for a moment).

go_status_failed.description: Status line on the trigger page when the split view could not be opened; an error box with the reason follows.

go_status_kept.message: 搜索结果已在右侧新的拆分视图中打开，可以关闭本页。
go_status_kept.description: Status line on the trigger page after the results were opened in a new split view next to the current one and this tab could not close itself; tells the user they may close the page.

go_status_no_repeat.message: 本页不会自动重复打开拆分视图。
go_status_no_repeat.description: Status line when the user comes back to the trigger page via Back, Forward or reload: the page does not open the split view again by itself (a Run again button is offered).

go_btn_rerun.description: Button on the trigger page that runs the split search again after Back/Forward/reload.

go_btn_left_only.description: Button on the trigger page error screen: open only the left engine's search (a normal search, no split view).

go_btn_open_options.description: Button in the trigger page error box that opens the extension's settings page.

go_err_no_trigger.message: 没有收到触发网址。请在地址栏搜索，或把文字拖到标签栏，不要直接打开本页。
go_err_no_trigger.description: Error on the trigger page when it was opened without a trigger URL (e.g. typed directly); the user should start a search from the address bar or by drag-and-drop instead.

go_err_config_unreadable.message: 读取设置失败，触发网址也无法识别，没有可打开的搜索。请重新加载扩展后再搜索一次。
go_err_config_unreadable.description: Error on the trigger page: the settings could not be read and the trigger URL is not a usable http(s) URL, so not even the left search can be opened.

go_err_bad_template.message: $ENGINE$ 的网址模板无效，不能作左侧引擎。请到设置页检查它的网址。
go_err_bad_template.description: Error on the trigger page: the left engine's URL template is invalid; the user should check it on the settings page. The placeholder is the engine name (not translated).

go_err_bad_url.message: 触发网址无法识别，可能被截断或改动过。请重新搜索，或到设置页重新复制触发网址。
go_err_bad_url.description: Error on the trigger page: the trigger URL cannot be parsed; the user should search again or copy the trigger URL again from the settings page.

go_err_not_left.message: $ENGINE$ 的网址不能作左侧引擎。请到设置页检查它的网址，或改用别的引擎作左侧。
go_err_not_left.description: Error on the trigger page: the left engine's URL template cannot be used as the left side of a split view. The placeholder is the engine name (not translated).

engine_tpl_ok.description: Live hint under the URL template field in the engine dialog: the template can be used on either side of the split view.

engine_tpl_right_only.message: 只能作右侧。可作左侧的网址要求：小写 %s 恰好出现一次，并且是某个查询参数的完整值（如 ?q=%s），该参数名只出现一次，网址不含 #
engine_tpl_right_only.description: Live hint under the URL template field: the template can only be used on the right side. Contains the full 'can be left side' rule; keep the rule wording identical to err_default_left_url. Do not translate %s, ?q=%s or #.

err_bad_url.description: Error: the URL (template or trigger URL) cannot be parsed.

err_tpl_no_placeholder.description: Error in the URL template field: the template lacks the lowercase %s placeholder. Do not translate %s.

err_tpl_bad_scheme.message: 网址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
err_tpl_bad_scheme.description: Error in the URL template field: the template does not use http or https.

err_tpl_no_host.description: Error in the URL template field: the template has no host name.

err_tpl_wildcard_host.message: 域名不能包含 *，请填写具体的网站地址
err_tpl_wildcard_host.description: Error in the URL template field: the host name contains a * wildcard.

err_tpl_ipv6.message: 不支持 IPv6 地址，请改用域名
err_tpl_ipv6.description: Error in the URL template field: the host is an IPv6 address literal.

err_tpl_reserved_param.message: _ss 是保留参数，网址中不能包含它
err_tpl_reserved_param.description: Error in the URL template field: the template contains the reserved _ss parameter. Do not translate _ss.

err_marker_format.message: 触发网址里的标记参数（_ss）格式不对，应为“左引擎,右引擎”。请到设置页重新复制触发网址。
err_marker_format.description: Error page after a search: the _ss marker parameter in the trigger URL is malformed.

err_unknown_engine.message: 这条网站搜索指向的引擎“$ENGINE_ID$”已被删除、隐藏或改名。请到 Chrome 搜索引擎设置里删掉或改正这条网站搜索，或在设置页重新添加这个引擎。
err_unknown_engine.description: Error page after a search: the trigger URL names an engine id that does not exist (deleted or hidden).

err_not_left.description: Error: the named engine's URL template cannot be used as the left side of a split view.

err_template_mismatch.message: 触发网址与左侧引擎当前的网址模板不一致，可能是引擎改过。请到设置页重新复制触发网址，并更新网站搜索。
err_template_mismatch.description: Error page after a search: the trigger URL no longer matches the left engine's current template; the user must copy the trigger URL again from the settings page.

err_config_too_large.description: Error when saving settings: one stored item exceeds chrome.storage.sync's per-item size limit. The placeholder is an internal storage key name (not translated).

err_name_required.description: Error in the engine dialog: the name field is empty.

err_name_too_long.message: 名称不能超过 $MAX$ 个字符
err_name_too_long.description: Error in the engine dialog: the name is longer than the maximum number of characters.

err_id_format.message: id 只能由小写字母、数字和 - 组成，长度 1–20
err_id_format.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine id has invalid characters or length.

err_id_taken.message: id “$ID$” 已被占用，请换一个
err_id_taken.description: Error in the engine dialog: another engine already uses this id.

err_id_exhausted.message: id “$ID$” 和 $ID$-2 至 $ID$-99 都已被占用，请先删除一些引擎再添加
err_id_exhausted.description: Error when adding from the engine catalog: the catalog id and every numbered variant (id-2 … id-99) are already used by other engines.

err_engine_gone.message: 找不到这个引擎，它可能已在其他设备上被删除
err_engine_gone.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine being edited no longer exists (probably deleted on another synced device).

err_default_left_url.message: 不能保存：这个引擎是默认组合的左侧，而新网址不能作为左侧。可作左侧的网址要求：小写 %s 恰好出现一次，并且是某个查询参数的完整值（如 ?q=%s），该参数名只出现一次，网址不含 #。如果确实要用这个网址，请先把默认组合的左侧换成其他引擎。
err_default_left_url.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine is the left side of the default pair and the new URL cannot be a left side. Contains the full 'can be left side' rule; keep the rule wording identical to engine_tpl_right_only. Do not translate %s, ?q=%s or #.

err_only_preset_hide.message: 只有预置引擎可以隐藏
err_only_preset_hide.description: Error: only preset engines can be hidden.

err_pair_uses_hide.message: 默认组合正在使用这个引擎，不能隐藏
err_pair_uses_hide.description: Error: the engine cannot be hidden because the default pair uses it.

err_only_custom_delete.message: 只有自定义引擎可以删除
err_only_custom_delete.description: Error: only custom engines can be deleted.

err_pair_uses_delete.message: 默认组合正在使用这个引擎，不能删除
err_pair_uses_delete.description: Error: the engine cannot be deleted because the default pair uses it.

err_pair_missing.message: 所选引擎不存在，可能已被删除或隐藏
err_pair_missing.description: Error when setting the default pair: a selected engine no longer exists (deleted or hidden).

err_quota_rate.message: 保存过于频繁，请稍后再试
err_quota_rate.description: Error when saving settings: chrome.storage.sync write rate limit reached.

err_quota_bytes.message: 同步存储空间已满，请删除一些自定义引擎或缩短名称和网址后再试
err_quota_bytes.description: Error when saving settings: chrome.storage.sync total storage quota is full.

options_title.description: Settings page title: browser tab title and the page heading. Keep the product name Split Search untranslated.

options_tagline.message: 在地址栏搜索或把文字拖到标签栏，一次用两个搜索引擎打开 Chrome 拆分视图。
options_tagline.description: One-line summary under the settings page heading.

options_pair_title.description: Heading of the settings card where the user picks the default engine pair (left and right engine).

options_pair_hint.message: 左侧只能选“可作左侧”的引擎。改了默认组合后，要把新的触发网址重新添加到 Chrome 并设为默认，旧的那条才会被替换。
options_pair_hint.description: Hint in the default pair card. "Can be left" refers to the engine tag engine_tag_left_ok; keep the same wording.

options_guide_title.description: Heading of the settings card that explains how to add the trigger URL to Chrome as a site search.

guide_steps_title.description: Subheading above the numbered setup steps.

guide_step_open_settings.message: 打开 Chrome 的搜索引擎设置。这个地址不能从网页里直接打开，请复制后粘贴到地址栏：
guide_step_open_settings.description: Setup step 1. The address chrome://settings/searchEngines and a Copy button follow right after this sentence, so it ends with a colon.

guide_copy_settings_url.description: Button next to chrome://settings/searchEngines in setup step 1: copies that address.

guide_step_add.message: 在“网站搜索”一栏点“添加”。
guide_step_add.description: Setup step 2. "Site search" and "Add" must match Chrome's own labels on chrome://settings/searchEngines in this language.

guide_step_fields.message: 名称随意（例如“Google ｜ Bing”）；快捷字词自定（例如 $KEYWORD$）；网址格式一栏粘贴上面复制的触发网址。保存。
guide_step_fields.description: Setup step 3: what to type into Chrome's site search dialog. "Shortcut" must match Chrome's label. The placeholder becomes the example shortcut (guide_example_keyword) shown as code.

guide_example_keyword.description: Example site search shortcut for a Google | Bing pair, shown as code in setup step 3. Pick a short, natural shortcut for this language; ASCII letters only.

guide_step_default.message: 默认组合：在刚添加的条目右侧 ⋮ 菜单里选“设为默认选项”。其他组合不用设为默认，在地址栏输入“快捷字词 + 空格 + 关键词”即可。
guide_step_default.description: Setup step 4. "Make default" and "shortcut" must match Chrome's labels; ⋮ is the More actions menu icon.

guide_step_grant.message: 确认左侧引擎已授权（引擎列表里显示“已授权”）。
guide_step_grant.description: Setup step 5. The quoted status must match engine_granted.

guide_caveats_title.description: Subheading above the list of caveats.

guide_caveat_degrade.message: 以下情况触发网址会降级为一次普通的左侧引擎搜索，不会打开拆分视图：同步了这套搜索设置的其他电脑和手机、无痕式窗口、扩展被停用、撤销了授权、引擎网站自己的 Service Worker 接管了导航。
guide_caveat_degrade.description: Caveat: cases where the trigger URL falls back to a plain search with the left engine. Keep Service Worker untranslated.

guide_caveat_no_suggest.message: 自己添加的网站搜索没有联想网址，设为默认后地址栏不再有搜索联想。
guide_caveat_no_suggest.description: Caveat: a user-added site search has no suggestion URL, so the address bar shows no search suggestions once it is the default.

guide_caveat_context_menu.message: 右键菜单里的“使用X搜索‘…’”同样会走触发网址，打开拆分视图。
guide_caveat_context_menu.description: Caveat: the right-click menu item "Search X for …" also uses the trigger URL and opens the split view. Match Chrome's wording of that menu item; X stands for the search engine name.

guide_caveat_sync.message: Chrome 的搜索引擎设置会同步到你的所有设备，但授权不会同步：每台设备都要在这个页面单独授权。
guide_caveat_sync.description: Caveat: Chrome syncs search engine settings to all devices but site access granted to the extension does not sync.

guide_caveat_template_change.message: 修改某个引擎的网址后，以它为左侧的网站搜索网址需要重新复制。
guide_caveat_template_change.description: Caveat: after changing an engine's URL, site searches that use it on the left must be copied again.

guide_caveat_remove.message: 删除或隐藏前，请先删掉 Chrome 里用到它的网站搜索：它作左侧的会退化为普通搜索，作右侧的会停在“未知引擎”错误页。
guide_caveat_remove.description: Caveat: delete Chrome site searches that use an engine before deleting or hiding it. "Unknown engine" refers to err_unknown_engine. Same text as the second paragraph of engine_confirm_hide / engine_confirm_delete.

options_engines_title.description: Heading of the settings card with the engine list.

options_add_engine.description: Button that opens the dialog for adding a custom search engine.

options_engines_hint.message: 网址模板中用 $CODE$ 代表关键词。左侧引擎的网站必须授权，右侧建议授权。排序决定下拉框里的顺序。
options_engines_hint.description: Hint under the engine list heading. The placeholder is %s shown as code.

options_hidden_title.description: Subheading above the list of hidden preset engines.

options_dlg_title_add.description: Engine dialog title when adding a new engine.

options_dlg_title_edit.description: Engine dialog title when editing an engine. The placeholder is the engine name (not translated).

options_dlg_id_hint_add.message: 小写字母、数字和 -，1–20 个字符。创建后不能修改，会写进触发网址。
options_dlg_id_hint_add.description: Hint under the id field when adding an engine: allowed characters and length; the id cannot be changed later because it is written into the trigger URL.

options_dlg_id_hint_edit.message: id 创建后不能修改（它写在已保存的网站搜索网址里）。
options_dlg_id_hint_edit.description: Hint under the read-only id field when editing an engine. Keep "id" as is.

options_dlg_id_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the id field: "e.g." plus an example id. Use the id of a search engine common in this language's market; lowercase letters, digits and - only, and it must match options_dlg_url_placeholder.

options_dlg_name_label.description: Label of the engine name field.

options_dlg_name_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the name field: "e.g." plus the name of the engine used in options_dlg_id_placeholder.

options_dlg_url_label.description: Label of the URL template field.

options_dlg_url_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the URL template field: the search URL of the engine in options_dlg_id_placeholder with %s as the query. It must be usable as the left engine: lowercase %s once, as the full value of a query parameter, no #.

options_dlg_preset_hint.message: 预置值：$NAME$，$URL$（改回这两个值即恢复预置）
options_dlg_preset_hint.description: Hint when editing a preset engine: shows its built-in name and URL; setting both back restores the preset.

options_dlg_edit_hint.message: 修改网址后，Chrome 里以该引擎为左侧的网站搜索需要重新复制网址。
options_dlg_edit_hint.description: Hint in the edit dialog: after changing the URL, site searches saved in Chrome that use this engine on the left must be copied again.

common_close.description: Accessible label of the × button that closes a notice.

common_copy.description: Copy button next to a URL.

common_copied.description: Copy button text for 1.5 seconds after copying succeeded.

common_left.description: Label of the left engine picker.

common_right.description: Label of the right engine picker.

common_pair_separator.description: Decorative separator between the left and right engine pickers; same mark as in guide_pair_label. Hidden from screen readers.

notice_copy_failed.message: 复制失败，请手动选中文字复制（$DETAIL$）
notice_copy_failed.description: Error notice when copying to the clipboard failed. The placeholder is the browser's error message.

notice_grant_failed.description: Error notice when the site access request failed. The placeholder is the error message.

notice_granted.description: Notice after the user allowed site access.

notice_grant_denied.message: 没有授权：弹窗被拒绝或关闭
notice_grant_denied.description: Warning notice when the site access prompt was denied or dismissed.

engine_list_empty.description: Shown in place of the engine list when it is empty.

engine_tag_left_ok.description: Tag on an engine row: the engine can be used on the left side.

engine_tag_right_only.description: Tag on an engine row: the engine can only be used on the right side.

engine_tag_default_left.description: Tag on the engine row that is the left side of the default pair.

engine_tag_default_right.description: Tag on the engine row that is the right side of the default pair.

engine_tag_custom.description: Tag on a user-added (custom) engine row.

engine_granted.description: Status on an engine row: the extension has access to the engine's site.

engine_not_granted_required.description: Status on the default left engine's row when its site is not granted; access is required.

engine_not_granted.description: Status on an engine row when its site is not granted.

engine_grant.description: Button on an engine row that asks Chrome for access to the engine's site.

engine_grant_named.description: Button that asks Chrome for access to the named engine's site.

engine_in_pair_title.message: 默认组合正在使用这个引擎
engine_in_pair_title.description: Tooltip of the disabled Hide/Delete button: the default pair uses this engine.

engine_hide.description: Button on a preset engine row that hides it.

engine_delete.description: Button on a custom engine row that deletes it.

engine_edit.description: Button on an engine row that opens the edit dialog.

engine_restore.description: Button on a hidden preset engine that shows it again.

engine_left_discouraged_hint.message: 建议仅作右侧：该站点的 Service Worker 可能接管导航，作左侧时可能不会打开拆分视图。
engine_left_discouraged_hint.description: Warning on an engine row (e.g. Perplexity): its site's Service Worker may take over navigation, so as the left engine the split view may not open. Keep Service Worker untranslated.

engine_move_up.description: Tooltip of the ↑ button that moves an engine up in the list.

engine_move_up_label.description: Accessible label of the ↑ button. The placeholder is the engine name.

engine_move_down.description: Tooltip of the ↓ button that moves an engine down in the list.

engine_move_down_label.description: Accessible label of the ↓ button. The placeholder is the engine name.

engine_hidden_empty.description: Shown when no preset engine is hidden.

engine_confirm_hide.message:
隐藏“$NAME$”？

删除或隐藏前，请先删掉 Chrome 里用到它的网站搜索：它作左侧的会退化为普通搜索，作右侧的会停在“未知引擎”错误页。
engine_confirm_hide.description: Confirmation dialog before hiding a preset engine. Keep the blank line (\n\n). The second paragraph is the same text as guide_caveat_remove.

engine_confirm_delete.message:
删除“$NAME$”？

删除或隐藏前，请先删掉 Chrome 里用到它的网站搜索：它作左侧的会退化为普通搜索，作右侧的会停在“未知引擎”错误页。
engine_confirm_delete.description: Confirmation dialog before deleting a custom engine. Keep the blank line (\n\n). The second paragraph is the same text as guide_caveat_remove.

engine_left_discouraged_suffix.description: Option in the left engine picker of the pair generator for an engine better used on the right (e.g. Perplexity). The placeholder is the engine name.

guide_default_tag.description: Tag on the trigger URL card for the default pair.

guide_pair_label.description: Name of an engine pair on the trigger URL card: left engine, a separator, right engine.

guide_pair_invalid.description: Shown on the trigger URL card instead of the pair name when the default pair is invalid.

guide_no_trigger.message: 无法生成触发网址，请检查默认组合的左侧引擎。
guide_no_trigger.description: Error on the trigger URL card when no trigger URL can be built for the default pair.

guide_default_hint.message: 按下方步骤添加为网站搜索后，在该条目的 ⋮ 菜单里选“设为默认选项”。之后地址栏直接搜索、拖拽文字到标签栏都会打开拆分视图。
guide_default_hint.description: Hint on the default pair card. "Make default" must match Chrome's label; ⋮ is the More actions menu icon.

guide_other_pairs_title.description: Title of the card that generates trigger URLs for other engine pairs.

guide_pair_shortcut_hint.message: 每个组合添加成一条网站搜索，用你自己定的快捷字词触发，例如在地址栏输入“$EXAMPLE$”。
guide_pair_shortcut_hint.description: Hint on the other pairs card. The placeholder is guide_example_shortcut_query.

guide_example_shortcut_query.description: Example of what to type in the address bar: a shortcut for a Kagi | Bing pair, a space, then the search words (the word for "keywords" in this language).

guide_no_left.description: Shown in the pair generator when no engine can be used on the left.

guide_not_left.description: Shown in the pair generator when the chosen left engine cannot be used on the left.

guide_left_not_granted.message: 左侧 $NAME$ 还没授权，这个组合不会打开拆分视图，只会打开普通的 $NAME$ 搜索。
guide_left_not_granted.description: Warning in the pair generator: the left engine's site is not granted, so this pair opens a plain search instead of a split view.

guide_left_discouraged.message: $NAME$ 建议只作右侧：它的网站用 Service Worker 接管页面跳转，作左侧时通常只会打开普通的 $NAME$ 搜索，不会打开拆分视图。作右侧不受影响。
guide_left_discouraged.description: Warning when an engine like Perplexity is the left side of a pair. Keep Service Worker untranslated.

notice_action_failed.description: Fallback error notice when an action failed without a known reason.

notice_save_failed.description: Error when saving settings failed. The placeholder is the reason (another message or a browser error).

notice_save_partial.message: 已保存，但有一项相关设置没能清除：$DETAIL$
notice_save_partial.description: Warning when the change was saved but a related setting (for example the chosen lookup or image search engine) could not be removed afterwards. The placeholder is the reason (another message or a browser error).

notice_saved.description: Notice after saving changes to an engine.

notice_needs_grant.message: 它的网站还没授权，请点该行高亮的“授权”按钮。
notice_needs_grant.description: Sentence shown right after notice_added / notice_saved when the engine's site is not granted yet. The quoted button is engine_grant.

notice_template_changed.message: “$NAME$”的网址已修改：以该引擎为左侧的网站搜索，需要在本页重新复制触发网址，并替换 Chrome 设置里对应网站搜索的网址。
notice_template_changed.description: Sticky notice after an engine's URL changed: site searches that use it on the left must be copied again and replaced in Chrome's settings.

notice_hidden.description: Notice after hiding a preset engine.

notice_deleted.description: Notice after deleting a custom engine.

notice_restored.description: Notice after restoring a hidden preset engine.

notice_order_save_failed.description: Error when saving the engine order failed. The placeholder is the reason.

notice_load_failed.description: Error when the settings could not be read. The placeholder is the reason.

notice_pair_saved.message: 默认组合已保存。记得把新的触发网址复制到 Chrome 并设为默认。
notice_pair_saved.description: Notice after changing the default pair: the new trigger URL must be added to Chrome and made default.

setup_title.description: Heading of the first-run “Get started” card at the top of the settings page.

setup_grant_title.description: Get started step 1 heading: grant access to the default pair's engine sites.

setup_grant_text.message: Split Search 要在左侧 $LEFT$ 的网站上把搜索转成拆分视图，所以必须授权这个网站。也授权右侧 $RIGHT$ 的话，下次搜索会直接更新已打开的拆分视图。只授权这两个网站。
setup_grant_text.description: Get started step 1: why access to the left (required) and right (recommended) engine sites is needed. Plain words, no talk of intercepting requests.

setup_grant_text_left.message: Split Search 要在左侧 $LEFT$ 的网站上把搜索转成拆分视图，所以必须授权这个网站。只授权这一个网站。
setup_grant_text_left.description: Get started step 1 when only the left engine needs access (the right one is the same engine or already granted).

setup_grant_both.description: Get started button that requests access to both default engines' sites: left required, right recommended.

setup_grant_left.description: Get started button that requests access to the default left engine's site (required).

setup_grant_right.description: Get started button shown after the left engine is granted: requests access to the right engine's site (recommended).

setup_granted.description: Get started step 1 status once the left engine's site is granted, next to a check icon.

setup_right_hint.message: 也建议授权右侧 $RIGHT$：下次搜索会直接更新已打开的拆分视图。
setup_right_hint.description: Get started step 1, after the left engine is granted: why the right engine's site is still worth granting.

setup_add_title.message: 在 Chrome 里添加网站搜索，并设为默认
setup_add_title.description: Get started step 2 heading. "Site search" and "Make default" are Chrome's terms (see docs/i18n/chrome-terms.md).

setup_add_text.message: 把下面的设置地址复制到地址栏打开，在“网站搜索”一栏点“添加”：名称随意，快捷字词自定，网址格式粘贴触发网址；保存后在这一条的 ⋮ 菜单里选“设为默认选项”。
setup_add_text.description: Get started step 2 in one sentence: open Chrome's search engine settings (address below), add a site search, fill in its three fields, save, and make it default. Field and menu names must match Chrome's labels; ⋮ is the More actions menu icon.

setup_trigger_label.description: Label above the default pair's trigger URL in Get started step 2.

setup_settings_label.description: Label above chrome://settings/searchEngines in Get started step 2.

setup_details_link.description: Link in Get started step 2 that jumps to the Add to Chrome card with the full steps.

setup_try_title.description: Get started step 3 heading: try a search and confirm that a split view opens.

setup_try_button.description: Get started step 3 button: opens a sample search with the default pair in a new tab.

setup_try_hint.message: 会用默认组合搜索“$QUERY$”。再到地址栏搜点什么，拆分视图打开了，就说明设置完成。
setup_try_hint.description: Under the Try it button: what it opens, and how to finish setup (a real search from the address bar). The placeholder is setup_sample_query.

setup_try_blocked.message: 先完成第 1 步的授权才能试。
setup_try_blocked.description: Inline reason next to the disabled Try it button: the left engine's site is not granted yet.

setup_sample_query.description: Sample search words the Try it button searches for. Pick a short, natural everyday search in this language (not about this extension).

setup_done_title.description: Get started card after setup is detected as complete (shown once, on the page that saw it).

setup_done_text.message: 在地址栏搜索，或把文字拖到标签栏，都会打开拆分视图。

setup_done_notice.message: 设置完成。在地址栏搜索或把文字拖到标签栏，都会打开拆分视图。
setup_done_notice.description: Notice announced when setup is detected as complete.

setup_regrant_title.description: Get started card heading when setup was done before but the left engine's site is not granted now.

setup_regrant_text.message: 左侧 $LEFT$ 没有授权，现在搜索只会打开普通的 $LEFT$ 搜索。
setup_regrant_text.description: Get started card when setup was done before but the left engine's site is not granted now: searches fall back to a plain search.

setup_revoked_notice.message: 左侧 $LEFT$ 的授权已取消，现在搜索只会打开普通的 $LEFT$ 搜索。
setup_revoked_notice.description: Notice when access to the default left engine's site is removed while the settings page is open.

options_left_not_granted.message: 左侧 $NAME$ 还没授权，目前搜索不会打开拆分视图，只会打开普通的 $NAME$ 搜索。
options_left_not_granted.description: Warning in the default pair card: the left engine's site is not granted, so searches open a plain search instead of a split view.

lang_label.description: Label of the language drop-down at the top of the settings page.

lang_auto.description: First option of the language drop-down: use the browser's language. The placeholder is the native name of the language the browser currently resolves to (one of the lang_name_* messages).

lang_note.message: 工具栏按钮的提示，以及 chrome://extensions 和 Chrome 应用商店详情页里的扩展简介，始终跟随浏览器语言，不受这里的选择影响。
lang_note.description: Note under the language drop-down: the extension description, the toolbar button tooltip, the description on chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing always follow the browser language, not this choice. Keep chrome://extensions as is.

lang_name_en.description: Native name of English in the language drop-down (本名，不要翻译): identical in every locale, do not translate.

lang_name_zh_cn.description: Native name of Simplified Chinese in the language drop-down (本名，不要翻译): identical in every locale, do not translate.

lang_name_zh_tw.description: Native name of Traditional Chinese in the language drop-down (本名，不要翻译): identical in every locale, do not translate.

lang_name_es.description: Native name of Spanish in the language drop-down (本名，不要翻译): identical in every locale, do not translate.

options_narrow_label.message: 窗口较窄时，右侧改在后台标签页打开
options_narrow_label.description: Checkbox label in the default pair card. Narrow means the window is under 960 px wide.

options_narrow_hint.message: 窗口宽度不到 960 像素时，拆分视图会太挤。勾选后，左侧结果留在你搜索的标签页，右侧结果在它旁边的标签页打开。
options_narrow_hint.description: Hint under the narrow-window checkbox on the settings page, describing what happens when it is checked. Split view is Chrome's feature name; keep the Chrome term. Do not say "this tab": the reader is on the settings page.

notice_narrow_saved.description: Notice after toggling the narrow-window checkbox.

catalog_cat_translate.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Translation.

catalog_cat_reference.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Reference.

catalog_cat_video.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Video.

catalog_cat_dev.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Development.

catalog_cat_maps.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Maps.

catalog_cat_academic.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Academic.

catalog_cat_shopping.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Shopping.

catalog_cat_chinese.description: Category heading in the engine catalog dialog: Chinese-language sites (Baidu).

catalog_cat_ai.description: Catalog category heading: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude). The prompt is prefilled, not sent.

err_catalog_already_added.message: 你的引擎列表里已经有“$NAME$”了。
err_catalog_already_added.description: Error when adding a catalog engine that already exists. $NAME$ is the engine name.

err_not_results_page.message: 页面已经变了，请重新点一下工具栏按钮。
err_not_results_page.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: the page is no longer a recognized search results page (navigated away, closed, joined a split view or the query is gone) when the user clicked an engine.

err_window_unsupported.message: 这个窗口不能使用拆分视图。
err_window_unsupported.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: the current window can't hold a split view (for example a popup or picture-in-picture window).

err_split_failed.message: 右侧的搜索没能打开，请再试一次。
err_split_failed.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: opening the right-side search failed.

err_message_rejected.message: 这次没有成功，请重新点一下工具栏按钮再试。
err_message_rejected.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: the extension rejected the request (unknown sender, bad fields, or the chosen engine is no longer available).

options_add_from_catalog.description: Button next to 'Add engine' that opens the engine catalog dialog.

catalog_title.description: Title of the engine catalog dialog.

catalog_hint.message: 这些网站适合放在拆分视图右侧。添加后和其他自定义引擎一样，可以修改或删除。
catalog_hint.description: Short intro in the engine catalog dialog. Custom engine = user-defined search engine entry.

catalog_add.description: Button on a catalog row that adds the engine.

catalog_added.description: Disabled button on a catalog row whose engine is already in the list.

catalog_add_aria.description: Accessible name of the Add button on a catalog row. The placeholder is the engine name. Must contain the visible text of catalog_add word for word (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name).

catalog_added_aria.description: Accessible name of the disabled Added button on a catalog row. The placeholder is the engine name. Must contain the visible text of catalog_added word for word (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name).

notice_catalog_added.description: Notice after adding an engine from the catalog. $NAME$ is the engine name.

cmd_cycle_right.message: 把右侧换成下一个引擎
cmd_cycle_right.description: Description of the keyboard command, shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. The command switches the right side of a Split Search split view to the next engine in the rotation.

options_shortcut_title.description: Heading of the keyboard shortcut card on the settings page.

options_shortcut_hint.message: 在 Split Search 打开的拆分视图里按快捷键，右侧会换成下一个勾选了“参与快捷键轮换”的引擎。快捷键默认未设置，点“设置快捷键”到 Chrome 的“键盘快捷键”页面设置。
options_shortcut_hint.description: Hint in the keyboard shortcut card. The quoted checkbox label must match engine_cycle_label; the page name must match Chrome's own title of chrome://extensions/shortcuts (Keyboard shortcuts).

options_shortcut_label.description: Label before the current key combination (or the not-set text) in the keyboard shortcut card.

options_shortcut_unset.description: Shown instead of a key combination when the user has not bound the command. Use Chrome's own wording for an unbound shortcut (Not set).

options_shortcut_open.description: Button that opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts, where the user binds the key combination.

engine_cycle_label.description: Checkbox label on an engine row. Checked means the keyboard shortcut may switch the right side to this engine.

engine_cycle_aria.description: Accessible label of the rotation checkbox on an engine row. The placeholder is the engine name. Must contain the visible label text of engine_cycle_label word for word (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name).

popup_not_ours.message: 当前标签页不在 Split Search 打开的拆分视图中。
popup_not_ours.description: Explains that the toolbar popup has nothing to switch: the current tab is not in a split view that Split Search opened. "Split view" must match Chrome's term. Keep Split Search untranslated.

popup_query_label.description: Toolbar popup: label in front of the search terms of the current split view.

popup_lookup_label.description: Toolbar popup, lookup pair (the user's web page next to a lookup result opened from the right-click menu): label in front of what is being looked up: the selected text, or "Image: <host>" for an image. Used instead of "Search terms" because an image lookup has no search terms.

popup_empty_query.description: Toolbar popup: shown instead of the search terms when the search was empty.

popup_left_label.description: Toolbar popup: label in front of the engine shown on the left side of the split view.

popup_right_label.description: Toolbar popup: label in front of the engine shown on the right side of the split view.

popup_engine_deleted.description: Toolbar popup: shown instead of an engine name when that engine has since been deleted in settings.

popup_role_page.description: Toolbar popup, lookup pair (the user's web page next to a lookup result opened from the right-click menu): label in front of the user's own page. Used instead of "Left" because the user may have swapped the two sides.

popup_role_lookup.description: Toolbar popup, lookup pair: label in front of the engine showing the lookup result (the side the engine list switches). Used instead of "Right" because the user may have swapped the two sides.

popup_page_origin.description: Toolbar popup, lookup pair: shown as the "engine name" of the user's own page side. Do not say "current page": the popup may be opened from the lookup side.

popup_lookup_image.description: Toolbar popup, image lookup pair: shown instead of the search terms. The placeholder is the host of the image URL (for example img.example.com); the image itself is not loaded.

popup_switch_title.description: Toolbar popup: heading above the list of engines; clicking one loads it on the right side.

popup_lookup_switch_title.description: Toolbar popup, lookup pair: heading above the list of engines; clicking one loads it on the lookup side. Used instead of "Switch the right side to" because the user may have swapped the two sides.

popup_no_choices.description: Toolbar popup: shown instead of the engine list when there is no other engine to switch to.

popup_switch_failed.message: 引擎没换成，请再试一次。
popup_switch_failed.description: Toolbar popup: shown when switching to the clicked engine failed (the split view was closed or split up, or loading the engine failed). Doesn't say "right side": in a lookup pair the switched side may be on the left.

popup_open_options.description: Toolbar popup: button that opens the extension's settings page.

popup_complete_detected.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: shown when the current tab is a search results page of a configured engine. $ENGINE$ is the engine name, $QUERY$ the recognized search terms.

popup_complete_hint.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: heading above the engine buttons. Clicking one keeps the current page on the left and opens the same search with that engine on the right.

popup_complete_aria.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: accessible name of an engine button. Must start with the engine name, which is the button's visible text.

popup_complete_narrow.message: 窗口较窄，右侧已在旁边的标签页打开。
popup_complete_narrow.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: shown after the click when the window is narrow, so the right-side search opened in the background tab next to the current one instead of a split view.

popup_complete_plain.message: 没能组成拆分视图，已在旁边的标签页打开。
popup_complete_plain.description: Toolbar popup, completing a split view: shown after the click when Chrome couldn't put the two tabs into a split view; the right-side search opened in the tab next to the current one.

options_lookup_title.description: Title of the settings card for the right-click lookup feature (select text or right-click an image).

options_lookup_intro.message: 在网页上选中文字后右键，或直接在图片上右键，再选 Split Search 的菜单项。当前网页留在左边，结果在右边打开。
options_lookup_intro.description: Intro of the right-click lookup card. Menu items are added by Split Search to Chrome's right-click menu.

options_lookup_engine_label.description: Label of the dropdown that picks the engine used to look up selected text.

options_lookup_follow.message: 跟随默认组合的右侧（当前：$ENGINE$）
options_lookup_follow.description: First option of the text lookup dropdown: use whatever engine is on the right side of the default pair. $ENGINE$ is its current name.

options_image_engine_label.description: Label of the dropdown that picks the reverse image search engine.

options_image_add_catalog.description: Button that opens the catalog of reverse image search engines.

options_image_add_custom.description: Button that opens the dialog for adding a custom reverse image search engine.

options_image_note_embedded.message: 页面内嵌的图片没有公开网址，不能以图搜图，右键菜单里不会出现这一项。
options_image_note_embedded.description: Limitation note: images that exist only inside a page (no public URL).

options_image_note_login.message: 要登录才能看的图片，引擎多半拿不到。
options_image_note_login.description: Limitation note: images that need a login.

options_lookup_privacy.message: 选中的文字和图片网址只发给这里选的引擎。有些图片网址本身带访问凭证，发出去后引擎也能打开这张图；图片网址也可能看得出它来自哪个网站。
options_lookup_privacy.description: Privacy note: what is sent to the chosen engine.

catalog_image_title.description: Title of the dialog listing ready-made reverse image search engines.

catalog_image_hint.message: 添加后就是普通的自定义以图搜图引擎，可以选用，也可以删除。
catalog_image_hint.description: Short intro in the image search catalog dialog.

engine_confirm_delete_image.description: Confirmation before deleting a custom image search engine. $NAME$ is its name.

options_image_dlg_title.description: Title of the dialog for adding a custom image search engine.

options_image_url_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the address template field of an image search engine (example address with %s).

options_image_dlg_hint.description: Hint under the address template field of an image search engine. Keep %s as is.

notice_lookup_saved.description: Notice after choosing the text lookup engine.

notice_image_engine_saved.description: Notice after choosing the image search engine.

menu_lookup_text.message: 在拆分视图中用 $ENGINE$ 搜索“%s”
menu_lookup_text.description: Right-click menu item shown when text is selected on a web page: the page stays on the left and the text lookup engine opens on the right. $ENGINE$ is the engine name. Keep %s as is: Chrome replaces it with the selected text.

menu_lookup_image.message: 在拆分视图中用 $ENGINE$ 搜索图片
menu_lookup_image.description: Right-click menu item shown on an image on a web page: the page stays on the left and the image search engine opens on the right. $ENGINE$ is the engine name.
